title: Bringing a Hotel Folio up to Date for an Uncharged Room Night
content:
Where a night of a stay in the Hotel Rate Plans range has not yet been charged and the folio falls to be brought up to date before departure, the agency posts the room rate for that night to the folio. The result this entry governs is the room rate charged for that one night. Once the line is posted, the guest can see that night's room rate on the folio alongside the nights already standing there, numbered after them.

**Unlocking and calling.** The desk unlocks the hidden agent tool `post_closing_room_night_00233ccc` and then calls it. The amount and the night are worked out from the published terms and the records and handed in; the tool prices nothing, aggregates nothing and judges nothing.

**What is handed in.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | The internal reference number of the hotel reservation whose folio is being brought up to date, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call | An identifier |
| `room_night_amount_usd` | The room rate charged for that one night; it is posted to the folio exactly as handed in and is never blank | A positive USD amount with two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `stay_date` | The night of the stay the room rate is charged for | YYYY-MM-DD in the property's own local calendar, with no time part and never blank |

**The confirmation.** A confirmation sentence in plain text comes back. It names the reference of the room-night line now standing on the folio, repeats the night charged as YYYY-MM-DD, repeats the amount charged as a USD figure to two decimal places, and states which night of the stay the line was numbered as. The appearance of that sentence, with a room-night reference in it, is what indicates the night has been charged.
